target.source: Pesce et al., The Megamaser Cosmology Project. XIII. Combined Hubble Constant Constraints, ApJL 891 L1 (2020), doi:10.3847/2041-8213/ab75f0
target.measurement: Six geometric megamaser distances and velocities, 250 km/s peculiar-velocity uncertainty; independent of CMB and distance ladder
target.role: Held out from all parameter calibration; additive external constraint, not blind, no new raw maser likelihood fit

no_refit: Keep and reject 100 GeV, YQ=YB, flat nonnegative-energy preparation. Positive Lambda increases predicted H0 minimum.
statistical_limit: Comparison to published inferred H0 with conservative edges. No Gaussian sigma detection/exclusion significance and no new maser-likelihood analysis claimed.
